title: NFL Week 11 Recap: Commanders Walk-Off, Cowboys Score 51, 49ers 9–1 & Eagles Snap Skid 🏈
description:
Everything you missed from NFL Week 11: the Washington Commanders beat the Cincinnati Bengals 22–20 on Monday Night Football with a field goal as time expired, Brock Purdy threw three first-half touchdowns as the San Francisco 49ers beat the Minnesota Vikings 35–10 in Mexico City, Dak Prescott accounted for five touchdowns in the Dallas Cowboys' 51–30 win over the Tennessee Titans, the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 19–16 to snap a seven-game losing streak, and the Carolina Panthers edged the Baltimore Ravens 35–33. Plus every result, the playoff picture and the Thanksgiving games to watch in Week 12.

NFL scores, standings and live scores: https://scorebuzz.net

🏈 NFL Week 11 in about three minutes.

Washington won it at the buzzer on Monday night, Dallas put up 51, the 49ers rolled in Mexico City and the Eagles finally won again.

Best game of the week? 👇
